== Quest Start == Talk to Sarkis Ebonblade in the [[Plane of Sky]]. You say, 'hail Sarkis Ebonblade' :''Sarkis Ebonblade says 'Greetings. Have you come here to test your dark powers of skill and spell casting? '' :''Sarkis Ebonblade says 'You will be tested by either Gragrot or Tynicon. Choose one! '' = Gragrot = You say, 'I choose gragrot' :''Sarkis Ebonblade says 'Gragrot it is! Take this book (Shadowy Virtues) and read it. When you are finished, hand it back to me and I shall summon Gragrot to test you.'' :''Sarkis Ebonblade says 'Farewell. '' :''Gragrot says 'I am here to do your bidding, Shadowknight Spirit! '' You say, 'hail Gragrot' :Gragrot says 'Hail! So you think you are a mighty Knight of Shadows? We must test these skills. Are you ready to begin the test? Or do you think you have already proof of your deeds? '' You say, 'I have proof of my deeds' :''Gragrot says 'So you think you've proven yourself? Well bring me a Sphinx Eye Amulet or a Djinni Finger Ring to claim your just reward. '' You say, 'I am ready to begin the test' :''Gragrot says 'Great, let us waste no more time! I offer to you three challenges. Bash, smash, or slash? What do you wish to be tested in? '' == Shadow Knight Test of Bash == Gragrot says 'Gragrot like bashin. Gragrot say you like bashin too! Give Gragrot an ebon tessera, a sphinx eye opal, and a finely crafted amulet. Gragrot then give you sphinx eye amulet. '''Reward:''' {{:Amulet of the Sphinx Eye}} {| class="eoTable3" ! Smash, smash, and return a copper disk, a small sapphire, and a silvery ring. Then Gragrot give you djinni's finger ring. '''Reward:''' {{:Crimson Ring of the Djinni}} {| class="eoTable3" ! '''Reward:''' {{:Pegasus-Hide Belt}} {| class="eoTable3" ! Take this book (Knights of the Malign) and read it. When you are finished, hand it back to me and I shall summon Tynicon to test you. '' :''Sarkis Ebonblade says 'Farewell. '' :''Tynicon DLin says 'I am here to do your bidding, Shadowknight Spirit! '' You say, 'hail Tynicon DLin' :''Tynicon DLin says 'Hail! So you think you are a mighty shadowknight? Your dark magic is very important to us. Are you ready to be tested or could it be that you have come back in hopes of a trade? '' You say, 'I have come back in hopes of a trade' :''Tynicon DLin says 'Ahh, well, prove to me that you have passed these tests and are worthy to wield the power I grant. Bring me Rheumguls and I will replace it with something more fitting for your abilities. '' You say, 'I am ready to be tested' :''Tynicon DLin says 'Great, let us waste no more time! I offer to you four challenges. Disempowement, envenoming, raising of the dead, or necropotence. Choose one to be tested on. '' == Shadow Knight Test of Disempowerment == Tynicon DLin says 'Disempowerment, destroying goodly magic. Proceed upward through the sky and return to me a griffon statuette, a blood sky emerald, and rusted pauldrons. This will prove your abilities to me and I will reward you with the Blood Sky Faceplate. '''Reward:''' {{:Blood Sky Face Plate}} {| class="eoTable3" !
